entities.title: Names and name entry
entities.summary: Names are cleaned to what the font can draw, the entry types only its keys, and the keyboard drawn on screen is complete.
criteria: A name is cleaned to what the game's font can draw, up to 12 characters
The entry types capitals, digits, dots, hyphens and spaces, and M is a letter there
A signed-in player's default is their email before the @, in capitals, all typeable
Every typeable character has a key on screen, and keys don't overlap
Letters sit over their underlines and the cursor under the next free slot

checks.symbol: a name is cleaned to what the game's font can draw, up to 12 characters
name entry types capitals, digits, dots, hyphens and spaces; M is a letter there
a signed-in player's default name is their email before the @, in capitals, all typeable
the on-screen keyboard: every typeable character has a key, and keys don't overlap
name entry: letters over their underlines, the cursor under the next free slot, keys keep their frames

entities.title: Whole reigns in a real browser
entities.summary: The page, the keypad, the content policy and accessibility, checked by hand and with Playwright.
criteria: Full reigns on a desktop keyboard and on a phone in portrait and landscape, with no console errors and no page scroll
Live-region text, keyboard-only play, 44-pixel targets and flashing under 3 Hz

checks.description: Under wrangler dev, play full reigns with Playwright on a desktop and a phone in both orientations, watching the console and securitypolicyviolation events (docs/TEST-PLAN.md rows 10 and 11).
An accessibility pass: the live regions, keyboard-only play, the size of every touch target and the flash rate (docs/TEST-PLAN.md row 13).
